description: Search places to stay on Airbnb — apartments, houses, rooms, cabins, villas and hotels — in any city, region or country, for given dates and guests: price for the stay, rating and review count, Guest favourite / Superhost badges, beds and baths, coordinates, photos and a link that opens the same stay. Filter by room type, minimum bedrooms and total price. One page is up to 18 stays; `page` 2–15 for more (Airbnb caps a search at 270). Pass a listing's `id` to airbnb_listing for amenities, house rules and the host. Scraped live from airbnb.pl (typically ~1 s via direct fetch; ~10 s when it falls back to an unblocker). WITH checkin + checkout, `price` is the TOTAL for the whole stay for the given guests, all fees and taxes included (Airbnb's EU total-price display), in `currency`; `price_per_night` = price ÷ nights; `price_before_discount` is the struck-through total when discounted; `price_breakdown` lists Airbnb's own lines (e.g. '2 noce x 245,00 zł' → 490, 'Podatki' → 8). Stays of 28+ nights are quoted per month: `price` null, `price_per_month` set. WITHOUT dates, Airbnb prices each listing for its own suggested stay (its `stay`, usually ~5 nights soon), so prices are not comparable and not a quote — a `note` says so; pass dates to quote a trip. Only stays bookable for the given dates are listed. Result shape: { source, fetchedAt, query, search_url, place: { query, place_id, resolved, city, region, country }, stay: { checkin, checkout, nights } | null, guests: { adults, children, infants, pets }, currency, total_count, page, total_pages, count, listings: [...], note? } — the list key is `listings`; `total_count` is Airbnb's count of matches (more than it lets you page through). Each listing: { id, url, name, kind, city, details, bedrooms, beds, baths, host_type, rating, review_count, is_new, guest_favorite, superhost, badges, free_cancellation, stay, price_basis, price, price_per_night, price_per_month, price_before_discount, nights, currency, price_text, price_breakdown, lat, lng, photos }. `rating` is 0–5; `kind`/`city`/`details`/`price_text` are Airbnb's Polish wording (e.g. kind 'Mieszkanie' = apartment, 'Pokój' = room, 'Dom' = house); `host_type` is business | private; coordinates are approximate (Airbnb blurs them). An empty match answers count: 0 with a `note` saying why and what to change — that is a successful result, not an error.

checkin.description: Arrival date, YYYY-MM-DD (from today to about two years ahead). Pass together with checkout; omit both for Airbnb's own suggested dates.

checkout.description: Departure date, YYYY-MM-DD, after checkin (at most 365 nights; 28+ nights are quoted per month).

infants.description: Infants under 2 (not counted as guests). Default 0.

no_cache.description: Force a fresh fetch and bypass this server's result cache (5 min). Default false.

page.description: Results page, 1-based (18 stays per page, at most 15 pages). Default 1.

pets.description: Pets (limits results to pet-friendly stays). Default 0.

place.description: Where to stay — a city, region, area or country, as you would type it into Airbnb: 'Zakopane', 'Kraków', 'Mazury', 'Lisbon, Portugal', 'Tuscany'. Add the country to disambiguate. Latin script (diacritics are fine).

price_max.description: Maximum total price for the whole stay incl. fees, whole units of `currency` (needs dates).

price_min.description: Minimum total price for the whole stay incl. fees, whole units of `currency` (needs dates).

room_type.description: Only 'entire_home' (the whole place to yourself) or only 'private_room'. Default: any.

name: airbnb_search
title: Search Airbnb stays
